arguments.script: System.Collections.IEnumerator Check(){float previous=UnityEngine.Time.timeScale; UnityEngine.Time.timeScale=0; try { string[] cues={"gate","locked","platform_warn","platform_fall","growth_start","growth_end","strength_start","strength_end","warning","enemy_ghost","spawn","pause","resume","complete","fall_wind"}; foreach(var cue in cues){GameplayAudio.Play(cue,.02f); yield return null; var audio=UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectOfType<GameplayAudio>(); if(audio==null)throw new System.Exception("No audio router"); var voices=audio.GetComponents<UnityEngine.AudioSource>(); bool playing=false; foreach(var v in voices){if(v.pitch!=1f || UnityEngine.Mathf.Abs(v.volume-GameplayAudio.Gain)>.001f)throw new System.Exception("Pitch/gain mismatch"); if(v.isPlaying)playing=true;} if(!playing)throw new System.Exception("No playing voice: "+cue); } UnityEngine.Debug.Log("NATURAL_FOLEY_PLAY_PASS: 15 cues; active voices; pitch=1; preference gain; no preference writes."); }finally{UnityEngine.Time.timeScale=previous;} } return Check();
arguments.summary: Smoke-test all 15 natural audio cues at quiet volume without changing preferences or campaign progress
